payload.core_mechanism_summary: For each start station, compute max over stations j with candies of (distance to j + (count_j-1)*n + min_delivery_dist_from_j). Greedy exchange argument: load farthest candy first to minimize max completion time.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a greedy exchange argument by scheduling candies at each station in order of decreasing delivery distance, ensuring the last loaded has the shortest trip. This minimizes the worst-case delivery time.
